column2:
The New Bronquian Empire's sudden attack,
and the fall of Karona, the fortress city
in the Kingdom of Fantasinia's north—
the news shook not only Fantasinia
but the entire continent.
The long age of peace and prosperity
had come to an end...
Little by little, the tide of war rose.
Bracing for the decisive battle to come,
each power quietly began to arm itself.
All watched each other's every move,
unrest flared up across the land,
and the world stood on a knife's edge.
It was truly an age of rival warlords.
Willing or not, the people were
swept up into the turmoil of war...
While new powers rose across the land,
others were culled and faded away.
A world of chaos......
To fulfill their own ambitions,
many mighty ones blazed across
the world: an age of flame and steel...
Some with their wisdom,
and some by force of arms,
set out to repaint
that world of chaos...

column2:
Ruled by the Flame Emperor Gulcasa,
a military nation in the continent's
northwest, home to a wealth of
battle-hardened generals and
well-drilled elite soldiers.
With its ample forces as its weapon,
it can fight a steady war!

A kingdom reigning over the heart
of the continent. Once home to many
sages, it kept expanding its power,
but with the rise of the Bronquian
Empire it now faces its downfall.
Spreading first to the southeast
to grow its power may be the key.

A band of noble thieves led by
Milanor, the thief king feared as
the Silver Wolf. Its fearless valor
and phantom-like speed have made
its name ring out to the far frontier.
Defeat the nearby powers to lay
the groundwork for unification.

The water folk's duchy in the
continent's southeast, ruled by
Queen Emelone. A peace-loving race,
yet they are said to fight without
fear once an enemy appears.
Their forte, fighting in the water,
may be the shortcut to victory.

A self-governed domain in the
Verlaine Hills, east of the continent.
Roswell, young head of House Branthese
of the Black Rose crest, harbored
dreams of uniting the land...
Settle the feud with rival House
Esmeralda fast, and ready for the rest.

A self-governed domain in the
Verlaine Hills, east of the continent.
Rosary, young head of House Esmeralda
of the White Rose crest, had awaited
the hour to settle with her neighbor...
Settle the feud with rival House
Branthese fast, and ready for the rest.

An armed band led by Brigand King
Ortega, holed up in the Lenessey
Mountains. Quick to smell gold,
their natural cheer lets them toy
even with the great nations.
Hold the great nations in check
and grow your power bit by bit.

Ruffians under Dort, self-styled
Bandit King, who prowl the Nyllard
Desert. They are said to be such
a reckless lot that even armies
go out of their way to avoid them.
Bring the western lands to heel and
a way forward may come into view.

A religious nation in the continent's
southwest. With countless believers
across the land, it is said to hold
vast funds from their donations.

Far too weak yet to survive; finding
people skilled in war is a must.

Elite knights who endured harsh
training to guard the Meria faith.
Grieving the Theocracy's corruption,
they rise up for the sake of the
people. With foes on every side,
marching the army east
may be their way out.

A free-spirited band formed by
those who long for freedom.
Its members' beliefs vary and
they lack unity, but each one
is highly capable. As a mixed army
it is poorly balanced: building up
its forces is a must.

A dreadful army of those who bear
dark feelings, gathered around a
certain fallen angel. To take their
revenge on the gods, they begin a
war to conquer the continent. Its
cast is vicious and quirky: the key
is whether you can wield its power.

column2:
Having deposed the former emperor
and raised the New Bronquian Empire,
Gulcasa, after pacifying his own lands,
soon set his sights on uniting them all.

Under him served able generals, who led
his army to victory in the war against
the late emperor, and hardened elites.

With lightning war as his motto,
Gulcasa led these elite troops and
set out to invade the other nations...

As the turmoil of war rages everywhere,
Yggdra Yuril Artwaltz, young princess
of the Kingdom of Fantasinia, who wishes
for stability in all the land, not only
her own domain, at last resolves to give
herself to the fight to bring peace.

Seeking a way to peace other than force,
the young princess, with the Holy Sword
of her royal line as her strength, bravely
faces the mighty foe closing in on her...

In a world where the weak are made to suffer,
Silver Wolf Milanor leads a band of thieves.
They always resented it, and one day he
sees that the oppressors, worn down by
long years of war, have grown weaker
than expected. He takes it as his chance.

With the comrades he trusts most,
to build a free world where no line
divides the mighty from the lowly,
he charges into the fray to strike down
the oppressors...

In a pure world by the waterside, the
Undines, water folk who shunned strife
and lived in quiet, were grieved by the
humans' repeated invasions.

Humans and the water folk had once
lived in harmony. So there must be a
reason they would turn to such folly...
So thought Emelone, queen of the water
folk, and seeking the answer, to strike
at its root, she dared to set out into
the very heart of the war...

Roswell, young head of House Branthese,
a family of the Black Rose crest that has
bred great mages for generations, worked
day after day to revive the legendary
magic created by Baroi, its founder...
But one day the Black Rose lands were
attacked; in the chaos his research was
lost, and his lands were badly damaged.

For his honor, and to revive the magic,
Roswell sought new power, and led
his forces out on the march...

Rosary, young head of House Esmeralda,
a family of the White Rose crest that has
bred great mages for generations, vied
with her rival Roswell next door to revive
the legendary magic of Baroi, the founder.

Then the White Rose lands were attacked;
in the chaos her research was lost, and
her lands suffered a heavy blow.

Her research wiped clean, she found that
her knowledge had been used for war, and
to cut off the evil at its root, she made
her way into the heart of the turmoil...

Ortega, chief of a brigand band proud
of its brawn, longs to test how far his
strength will take him in these wild
times, and so, with his men in tow,
he takes on a reckless war: to go
as far as they can go.

Having never held land of their own
and used to wandering, his men gladly
join their chief's challenge and charge
into a world of warring rivals...

Unable to bear that Barabasa, the sun god
they worship, is scorned in the world
outside, Bandit King Dort resolves to act.
To spread the sun god's faith far and wide
and crush all other faiths, he gathers his
men and marches out of the desert.

Many hardships lay on the road ahead,
but carefree by nature, they had no fear,
and seeking their god and a good time,
they simply charged on and on...

Through the word of its god, the Meria
church had put down strong roots in every
land, growing for ages through its mighty
connections and influence.
But with Juvelon's faction came a hollow
doctrine, a rich-poor gap, and less income.

Alarmed, Cardinal Juvelon, seeking
still more income and new hunting grounds,
began an invasion that went by
the name of missionary work...

Driven out by their feud with Juvelon's
faction, the righteous Meria faithful,
with Pope Johaim to sustain their hearts,
kept the old faith and awaited the chance
to bring the true teachings back to the world.

Then Gordon, head of the Temple Knights,
returned from his pilgrimage, and the
moment drew ever nearer.
The Temple Knights' march
was about to begin...

Never at home in town, living quietly
far from human settlements, they
still sometimes longed to make
their presence known.

Having acted each on their own until
now, and each bitterly driven back,
they now banded together around Pamela
and boldly rose up against those who
came to ravage the forest, and those
who looked down on them...

Cast down from heaven by divine
punishment and sealed away for ages,
a lone fallen angel... Yet even after
that span, long as eternity, his hatred
of the gods had not faded, but had
only grown stronger...
At last able to move again, he
descended to the earth as Nessiah,
and to take his revenge on the gods,
first set out to seize rule of the land...

column2: ~ Reign of the Sun God of Chaos ~

After a long, long war, the New Bronquian
Empire achieved the unification of the land.
Keeping its strict discipline even after
the fighting ended, it remained a nation
unshaken for centuries to come.
And the great deeds of Gulcasa, the first
emperor, who built this great empire in a
single generation, were told and praised
for ages after...

Soon after unifying the land, Yggdra,
ruler of Fantasinia, declared that she
would lay down arms. The wounds the war
left on the world were deep, but the sight
of her striving, however unseasoned, to
mend the world at last moved many hearts,
and her will to save everyone was
embraced even by former enemy peoples.
In the end, after reconciliation,
true peace arrived...

Though once no more than a local band,
Milanor's Thieves, with their spirit of
helping the weak and crushing the strong,
at last united the people's hearts.
In this tide that yearned for freedom,
the war died down before long, and even
amid the toil of rebuilding a world laid
waste, smiles never left the people's faces;
and in time, a free world was built...

Through Queen Emelone's skill, charisma
and deeply loving nature, the age of
war quietly came to a close.
Firmly driving off invaders who came now
and then, the water folk, who by nature
shun strife, kept up their ties with humans,
and little by little the rift between them
closed, until a gentle, peaceful age came
when humans and Undines lived side by side...

A new magic nation under a young ruler...
Absorbing even rival House Esmeralda,
Roswell, head of House Branthese,
pursued his own research, and at last
succeeded in reviving the lost magic
said to have been created by Baroi,
the founder. Through the ancient wisdom
he revived, this nation of magic is said
to have flourished for all time...

A new magic nation under a young ruler...
Absorbing even rival House Branthese,
Rosary, head of House Esmeralda,
pursued her own research, and at last
succeeded in reviving the lost magic
said to have been created by Baroi,
the founder. Through the ancient wisdom
she revived, this nation of magic is said
to have walked the road of prosperity...

At the hands of insolent ruffians, the
world was united at the end of chaos,
but never having cared for ruling in the
first place, the freedom-loving brigands
cast off the ties of rank and honor,
gathered all the treasure they could carry,
and in time went back home to Lenessey,
where they lived merrily with their friends...

Relying on Barabasa, the sun god they
blindly believed in, the bandits who
climbed to the top of the world are said
to have run rampant everywhere, until
a rebel army formed by Temple Knights
they had let slip wiped them out as an
evil cult... After that, the faith in
Barabasa lived on only quietly, in remote
frontiers where people seldom went...

Through the holy doctrine of the Meria
faith and overwhelming economic might,
the Theocracy of Meria once unified the land...
But the anger of a people who grieved the
gap between rich and poor reached its limit;
rife with corruption, the nation sank ever
lower, riots to break the deadlock flared
everywhere, and an age of civil war began...

Once on the brink of ruin, persecuted by
Juvelon's faction of the Meria faith, the
Temple Knights, guided by God, won battle
after battle and at last unified the land.
True to justice to the very end, the Temple
Knights never forgot the true teachings
of the Meria faith and protected the
people for ages, and their fairness was
told as a fine tale for ages to come...

A mysterious power that appeared one day
like a comet... With wild, unpredictable
tactics they ran rings around every foe
they met, and at last, unstoppable,
unified the land. But a little later,
Pamela, the alliance's leader, vanished
together with the Undines.
Without her, the alliance lost its reason
to exist, and in time, split by differing
aims, it is said to have disbanded...

Having quelled the war humans could never
end, reaching the first stage of his goal,
Nessiah the Fallen Angel used all his power
to leave for the realm of the gods for revenge.
Many went with him on that campaign,
but it is said none ever returned...
Afterward, on the earth now without a ruler,
a struggle to choose a new ruler arose,
and the age of war went on and on...

column2: Fall of the Theocracy of Meria
War against the Duchy of Embellia

Through Queen Emelone's valiant fight,
the Duchy of Embellia has conquered
House Branthese, ruled by Roswell.

Roswell's sorcery-wielding troops gave
her a hard fight, but Emelone's greater
experience won the day, and House
Branthese fell to her.
Yet this war did not show her what she
seeks: "why people turn to evil."
And so the queen renews her resolve
to march her army onward...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
Wanting their selfishness, called
"freedom," to go unchecked, the Ortega
Brigands seek to rid themselves of the
rule-obsessed Temple Knights.

To Ortega the brigand king, those nagging
Temple Knights, ever in the way of his
men's free and easy ways, were nothing
but a nuisance.
His patience finally snapped. Resolved
to wipe out the Temple Knights, he
gathers his men and decides to invade
their lands to strike them down.
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
The Temple Knights have struck down
the hollow Theocracy of Meria, which
scorned the faith and chased only gold.

Temple Knight Commander Gordon struck
down the Theocracy, root of the rot,
to set the corrupt faith right and
mend the world. But he learns the rot
is not confined to the Theocracy:
it has spread to the world beyond.
To lay the path of true faith anew,
he sets out on a crusade against it!
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
After a fierce battle, the New Bronquian
Empire under Emperor Gulcasa has
overthrown Nessiah's Forces.

Mighty as Nessiah's army was, it fell
at last to Emperor Gulcasa's breaking
power and his generals' skilled tactics,
and the New Bronquian Empire grew
greater still.
But Gulcasa's army, as if it knew no
rest, marches on and on...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
Where does human greed come from...?
To find out, Queen Emelone marches
on House Branthese.

The Verlaine Hills, close to the Duchy
of Embellia, were long home to two noble
houses: House Esmeralda, whose crest
is the White Rose, and House Branthese,
whose crest is the Black Rose.
Queen Emelone chooses the latter,
House Branthese, as her target
and begins her march!
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
The Ortega Brigands have finally
crushed the Forest Alliance, a thorn
in their side.

Having wiped out the Forest Alliance,
which he saw as handy for testing his
strength, Ortega the brigand king gets
serious and leads his men onward to
invade yet another land...
Riding high, can anyone stand in
the way of Ortega and his men...?
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
The Temple Knights had always doubted
the ways of Juvelon's Theocracy of Meria.


Gordon, the Temple Knights' commander,
had long resented Juvelon's rule: no help
for the poor, only endless greed for
gold. Through it, Gordon learned of the
Church's many corruptions, and one day
he resolved to set the world right and
turned his army on the Theocracy.
Will his wrath, and the people's pain,
ever reach Juvelon...?
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
By Emperor Gulcasa's order, the New
Bronquian Empire marches to purge
Nessiah's Forces, which it cannot ignore.

Nessiah's Forces lay right beside the
New Bronquian Empire. For the Empire,
their holding that ground was like a
sword held to its throat.
Unable to let that stand, Emperor
Gulcasa resolved to send his army to
crush Nessiah's Forces and wipe them
from existence.
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
Under Queen Emelone's command, the
Duchy of Embellia has defeated
Milanor's Thieves.

As befits a man called the thief king,
Milanor's band was a tough foe, but the
queen's tenacious command paid off,
and at last the thieves were swept away...
Yet this war did not show her what she
seeks: "why people turn to evil."
The queen resolves to march her
army onward...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
The Forest Alliance haunts the nearby
woods. Ortega, who finds it a pest,
decides to crush it.

His men had sometimes gone into the
woods and come back hurt, so Ortega
the brigand king, who found the Alliance
an eyesore, gathers his men to hunt it
down, just to see how it goes. Ortega,
surprisingly caring of his men, also set
up this campaign to train them...
How will it turn out...?
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
With Emperor Gulcasa's lightning attack,
the New Bronquian Empire has subdued
the Kingdom of Fantasinia.

The Royal Army fought well, but it was
no match for the New Bronquian Empire,
with its elite troops and fine generals,
and the royal capital, Paltina, fell.
Scattered raids by fleeing royal soldiers
were soon crushed, and the kingdom
was brought to order. Emperor Gulcasa
now turns his greater ambitions on
the forces around him...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
Bandits run rampant across the land.
Queen Emelone judges that unless they
are removed, she can never rest easy.

Fearing a threat ever at her back,
Queen Emelone strikes first, crossing
the border to crush the thieves led by
Milanor, the thief king.
She also thought that by defeating
the thieves she might learn where
human greed comes from...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
After many campaigns, Nessiah's Forces
have vastly widened the land they hold.


With its conquests, Nessiah's Forces
gained great power, and its presence
cast the whole continent into the
depths of fear.
But the nations around them did not
look on in silence: they readied for
the next war, building their strength...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
By Emperor Gulcasa's order, the New
Bronquian Empire has begun its invasion
of the Kingdom of Fantasinia.

Emperor Gulcasa began his march into the
heart of the continent to subdue the
Kingdom of Fantasinia, his sworn enemy.
If that kingdom falls, mastery of the
continent is as good as the New
Bronquian Empire's.
The hour of the decisive battle has come!
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
After fierce fighting, the Theocracy of
Meria has vastly widened the land it
rules (and where it preaches its faith).

With its wider rule came great wealth,
and the name of Juvelon rang out
across the continent.
But the nations around them did not
look on in silence: they readied for
the next war, building their strength...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
Awakened from a long sleep, Nessiah and
his forces have at last destroyed one
of their goals: the Kingdom of Fantasinia.

The Royal Army fought well, but it had
no answer to the demonic army of
Nessiah's Forces; many soldiers were
slain, and the royal capital, Paltina, fell.
Having destroyed the Kingdom of
Fantasinia, Nessiah marches his army
onward across the land to bring the
whole continent to heel...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
After its campaigns, House Esmeralda
has vastly widened its domain.


With its wider domain came great military
might, and the name of Rosary rang out
across the continent.
But the nations around them did not
look on in silence: they readied for
the next war, building their strength...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
The Theocracy of Meria has subdued the
Duchy of Embellia, land of the Undines,
beings strange in its eyes.

Heeding his narrow-minded men, who
hate those with other values or other
shapes, Juvelon sent his troops into the
Duchy of Embellia. Having beaten it after
fierce fighting, they now seek new lands
whose wealth can make good their losses,
pressing on with conquest in the name
of spreading the faith...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
After a hard campaign, Milanor's Thieves
have vastly widened the land they freed.


With more land freed came great power,
and the name of Milanor the thief king
rang out across the continent.
But the nations around them did not
look on in silence: they readied for
the next war, building their strength...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
To Nessiah, the Kingdom of Fantasinia,
home of Yggdra and the Holy Sword, stood
in the way of his ambitions...

The greatest threat in this world is
the Holy Sword in Fantasinia...
Dispose of the princess who wields it,
and no one could ever stop him...
So thinking, Nessiah set his sights on
the Kingdom of Fantasinia and, leading
his army, gleefully began his invasion...!
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
By force of arms, House Esmeralda has
crushed the Forest Alliance, whose
leader has great magic, yet which kept
staging near-terrorist raids.

To Rosary, the Forest Alliance was an
unreasonable lot. Perhaps it lacked
unity, for it could not hold back House
Esmeralda's assault...
But even after crushing it, Rosary had
not gained the power to revive the
legendary magic, and so she marches
her army on in search of more power...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
Juvelon could not, by the creed, allow
beings of strange shape to exist, but
above that, he had long wanted more
lands that could bring in income.

Ruling a Theocracy of Meria whose income
was falling, maybe from hard times,
Juvelon wanted new lands as a source of
funds, and eyed the land of those strange
beings... the Duchy of Embellia.
Call it spreading the faith, and few
would object. The Theocracy swiftly
resolved to send a punitive army there...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
For a world of freedom and equality...
Milanor's Thieves have defeated their
greatest obstacle, the Bronquian Empire.

Emperor Gulcasa and his army were truly
mighty, but by beating the generals one
by one, spread thin to guard the vast
empire, the thieves won in the end.
The world they long for is near...
Feeling so, Milanor presses on
still further.
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
With that ominous power, Nessiah and his
forces have destroyed the New Bronquian
Empire, which stood in his ambition's way.

Famed for its fine officers and great
might, the New Bronquian Empire's army
fought hard, elite troops and generals
alike, but at last every land fell to
Nessiah's demonic armies.
Yet this was only the beginning of
Nessiah's ambition...
In search of more sacrifices, the march
of Nessiah's Forces goes on...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
House Esmeralda, led by Rosary, moves
to drive out the Forest Alliance, a band
whose aims no one can read.

Sensing one of great magical power in
the Forest Alliance, the young ruler
Rosary resolves to send her army to
break up their band and capture the
one who holds that great power.
Will she find the power to help
revive the legendary magic...?
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
The Theocracy of Meria has rid itself
of the cheeky Temple Knights and their
endless pretty words.

Juvelon, who had long found the Temple
Knights and their nagging a nuisance,
has at last torn them out by the root.
With no more meddlers to butt in, a
delighted Juvelon, eager for more
income, seeks new lands to fund him,
pressing on with conquest in the name
of spreading the faith...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
After their fight to win freedom,
Milanor's Thieves have at last reached
the lands of the New Bronquian Empire.

The foe is mighty, but Milanor the thief
king and his friends, reckless by nature,
fearlessly decide to attack the empire.
For its part, the Imperial Army, never
dreaming that mere bandits would attack
it, had let its guard down completely.
Seizing on that gap, Milanor and his
friends head for the first stronghold!
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
To realize his ambition, Nessiah begins
to stir, aiming to wipe out the New
Bronquian Empire that stands in his way.

The power of the demon dragon that
Emperor Gulcasa holds was one thing
that could thwart Nessiah's ambition.
To strike it down, he gathers his forces
and turns them on the New Bronquian
Empire. The Empire is mighty, but if he
cannot beat it, his ambition is lost.
Staking all his godlike might, Nessiah
invades the Empire's lands...!
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
House Esmeralda has absorbed its old
foe, House Branthese.


Defeating House Branthese was Rosary's
long-held dream, but she realizes the
power won in this war alone will not
revive the legendary magic she seeks.
Where is the power she needs?
In search of that great power,
Rosary marches her army onward...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
Juvelon's Theocracy of Meria has always
seen the Temple Knights as a thorn in
its side.

One day it came out that Juvelon had
forced huge donations even from the
poor, and Gordon, the Temple Knights'
commander, gave him a stern scolding.
Now finding them more hateful than ever,
Juvelon at last sends his army, resolved
to wipe the Temple Knights from this
world.
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
A foe they could never get along with...
Milanor's Thieves have subdued the
Ortega Brigands.

What began as petty scuffles grew into
a feud and at last into all-out war, but
the strife between brigands and thieves
ended with the Ortega Brigands broken up.
Emboldened, Milanor's Thieves set out
for their next goal, to make their army
and their ranks stronger still!
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
Seeking to revive the legendary magic,
House Esmeralda has resolved to subdue
the neighboring House Branthese.

Rosary, the young ruler of House
Esmeralda, recognized the natural
talent of Roswell, her longtime rival
and ruler of the house next door.
If she could make use of that power,
reviving the legendary magic would be
certain... So thinking, she gathers her
troops and marches on House Branthese.
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
Milanor's band of thieves has set out
to deal a blow to the Ortega Brigands,
who never got along with them.

Out of pride as noble thieves, or seeing
them as business rivals...
Milanor's Thieves, long at odds with the
Ortega Brigands, cross the border to
strike them first.
Milanor, whose motto is lightning war,
thought that now he could crush the
Ortega Brigands utterly...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
After fierce fighting, the Forest
Alliance has widened its domain further.


With a wider domain came great power,
and the name of Pamela-sama rang out
across the continent.
But the nations around them did not
look on in silence: they readied for
the next war, building their strength...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
Advance upon advance has widened the
domain of Dort's Bandits.


With a wider domain came great power,
and the name of Dort the bandit king
rang out across the continent.
But the nations around them did not
look on in silence: they readied for
the next war, building their strength...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
Through Pamela-sama's super-lightning
strategy, the Forest Alliance has
destroyed the Theocracy of Meria.

Pamela-sama declared war, out of the
blue, on the Theocracy of Meria, which
had treated witches worst of all, even
before its corruption. With no interest
in riches this time, she could not be
bought off, and the Theocracy swiftly
collapsed. Pleased, she pushes the
front line further...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
After its advance, House Branthese has
vastly widened its domain.


With its wider domain came great military
might, and the name of Roswell rang out
across the continent.
But the nations around them did not
look on in silence: they readied for
the next war, building their strength...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
On the bandit king's personal whim,
Dort's Bandits have brought down
House Esmeralda.

Dort the bandit king, fond of drink but
fonder still of beauties, went after
Rosary, House Esmeralda's ruler, found
at the end of his holy war, and at last
took her lands. Fired up still more by
this string of battles, his heart seemed
beyond anyone's restraint...
What awaits him on the road ahead?
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
After many campaigns, the Kingdom of
Fantasinia has vastly widened its domain.


With more lands came great national
strength, and the name of Princess
Yggdra rang out across the continent.
But the nations around them did not
look on in silence: they readied for
the next war, building their strength...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
The Forest Alliance was searching for
a target to lift its somewhat gloomy
spirits...

Lately, it learned that a nation called
the Theocracy of Meria was treating
unit classes such as Undines and Witches
with harsh discrimination.
Hearing this, Pamela-sama declared the
Theocracy of Meria a nation of villains
and, to punish it, suddenly invaded at
the head of her troops...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
Roswell, who hates all that offends his
sense of beauty, has wiped out the worst
offender of all: Dort's Bandits...

Offensive to his taste or not, the
bandits were a force not to be taken
lightly, but once Roswell got serious
he beat them.
Here their sun-god faith meets its end.
Yet he could not revive the legendary
magic, and so Roswell marches his
army onward in search of more power...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
Dort the bandit king had long been
fond of drink, but fonder of beauties...


One day he learned that the ruler of
House Esmeralda was a young, beautiful
woman. Dying to see for himself, he put
his sun-god faith aside and declared an
invasion of House Esmeralda.
But his men shared his tastes and aims,
so not one of them opposed the plan...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
Was the Holy Sword's power so great...?
Fantasinia has crushed Milanor's
Thieves, mightier than many an army.

The thief king Milanor, the Silver Wolf,
was as fearsome as they say, yet Princess
Yggdra's courage and endurance, and the
deeds of the knights who follow her,
brought him to heel.
But the flames of war across the land
still burn, ever fiercer. Until they die,
true peace will not come.
Yggdra's fight goes on...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
Pamela-sama, the Forest Alliance's
leader, long fascinated by the Undines,
has at last subdued the Duchy of Embellia.

But the Duchy of Embellia, home of the
Undines she had dreamed of for years,
fought back hard, and when the fighting
ended it lay in ashes, a sorry sight...
Now unable to have her way with the
Undines, Pamela-sama is furious!
Half in a fit of pique, she turns her
wrath on other nations.
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
On the young lord Roswell's whim, House
Branthese begins its march to wipe out
the bandits led by Dort.

Lord Roswell had long ignored them,
but a clash grew unavoidable, so he
resolved to deal Dort's Bandits a blow
they could never recover from.
Besides, even bandits like them might
hold power that could help revive the
legendary magic. So thinking, Roswell
marches on the bandits' lands.
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
Dort's Bandits, who worship the sun
god, have defeated the hated heretics,
the Theocracy of Meria.

The Theocracy of Meria, head temple of
the heretics, boasted strong forces
raised by its rich coffers, but it was
only a band of hired soldiers, no match
for Dort's battle-hardened bandits.
Flush with funds from this war, Dort
turns his troops outward to spread
his sun-god faith further...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
Princess Yggdra of Fantasinia has
resolved to send her army to put down
Milanor's Thieves, rampant nearby.

The thieves led by Milanor, the Silver
Wolf, being noble thieves as they claim,
never took the people's lives. Rather,
the very idea of noble thieves struck
hard at the rulers of the nation.
To protect the nation's authority,
Princess Yggdra launches a campaign
to put them down.
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
The Forest Alliance, led by Pamela-sama,
has set its sights on the Duchy of
Embellia, to get its hands on Undines.

Pamela-sama, the Forest Alliance's
leader, needed Undines to complete her
years of research...
So, hastily cooking up an excuse to
attack the Duchy of Embellia, she
launched a lightning invasion with
her army...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
House Branthese has absorbed its
longtime rival, House Esmeralda.


By ending this feud, Lord Roswell has
gained great power. Yet he realizes that
defeating House Esmeralda alone will
not revive the legendary magic.
To achieve his wish, Roswell marches
his army on in search of power...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
Dort the bandit king crosses the border
to spread his sun-god faith in the
Theocracy of Meria, a heretic nation
that offends his eye.

To Dort the bandit king, nothing was
less forgivable than scorning the sun
god, and the Meria faith was that very
heresy made flesh.
Crush them and convert them, and sun-god
believers would boom... So thinking,
Dort launches his invasion of the
Theocracy of Meria.
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
With Princess Yggdra's valor, Fantasinia
has ended its war with its sworn enemy,
the New Bronquian Empire.

Once it lost the border city of Karona
and was driven to the brink, but the
rare devotion of the units sworn to
Princess Yggdra turned the tide, and
the imperial forces were swept away.
But the flames of war across the land
still burn, ever fiercer. Until they die,
true peace will not come.
Yggdra's fight goes on...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
To revive the legendary magic, House
Branthese has resolved to subdue the
neighboring House Esmeralda.

To break the deadlock, Lord Roswell
launches a plan to absorb his fated
rival, House Esmeralda, sending every
soldier he has against his neighbor.
Win this war, and the lands split for
so many years will be one again, and
the legendary magic may be revived...
So thinking, Roswell heads for the front.
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
To check its sworn enemy, the New
Bronquian Empire, Fantasinia marches
on the imperial homeland.

To secure order and peace across the
continent, Princess Yggdra, resolved to
march on the New Bronquian Empire,
gathers her main force and leads it
into imperial lands.
Win this battle, and the kingdom's
greatest threat will be gone.
On whom will the goddess of victory
smile...?
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
After many campaigns, the Temple Knights
have restored order across wide lands.


With wider reach came great power,
and the name of Gordon rang out
across the continent.
But the nations around them did not
look on in silence: they readied for
the next war, building their strength...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
After fierce fighting, the Ortega
Brigands have widened their domain.


With a wider domain came great power,
and the name of Ortega the brigand king
rang out across the continent.
But the nations around them did not
look on in silence: they readied for
the next war, building their strength...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
Through Commander Gordon's justice and
efforts, the Temple Knights have at last
defeated Milanor's Thieves.

Unable to let pass the wrong of taking
what belongs to others, Gordon, in his
sense of justice, attacked Milanor's
Thieves and defeated them.
Learning that there are people to
protect in the world beyond, he carries
on his crusade against evil, to lay the
path of true faith anew...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
Through Queen Emelone's deeds, the
Duchy of Embellia has widened the lands
it has brought to order.

With those wider lands came great power,
and the name of Queen Emelone rang out
across the continent.
But the nations around them did not
look on in silence: they readied for
the next war, building their strength...
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
Hating those who mouth pretty words,
the Ortega Brigands have defeated the
Temple Knights.

Hating, above all, any limit on what
they do, they could never get along with
the Temple Knights, keepers of order;
in time it came to blows, and at last
the Temple Knights were wiped out.
With that nuisance gone, can anyone
stand in their way...?
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
The Temple Knights under Gordon could
not let pass the taking of what belongs
to others, noble thieves or not.

Milanor's Thieves may share their spoils
with the people, but where that money
comes from is the problem. In regions
beyond the reach of law and order,
nothing can stop them. So Gordon, the
Temple Knights' commander, resolves to
ride out himself, wipe out the thieves
and restore order.
How will the battle turn out?
column3: font=sans-b align=l size=12 box=19,0,220,234 rows=13 maxw=220

column2:
After many campaigns, the New Bronquian
Empire has vastly widened its realm.


With more lands came great national
strength, and the name of Emperor
Gulcasa rang out across the continent.
But the nations around them did not
look on in silence: they readied for
the next war, building their strength...
